newsitem.title: UK: BTR jumps on bullish press comment.
newsitem.headline: BTR jumps on bullish press comment.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc jumped to a two-month high on Friday, extending this week's sharp gains, after a bullish press comment reignited buying interest, dealers said.
By 0848 GMT, the shares were up 9p to 268-1/2 on turnover of 3.1 million shares. They were the second most actively traded shares in London.
The Financial Times influential Lex Column raised hopes that the UK industrial conglomerate will reap benefits from its restructuring.
"With expectations this low," the newspaper said, "it is hard to imagine that the recent restructuring cannot deliver some pleasant surprises."
A dealer noted, "This was the first good comment on BTR we've seen in a while."
The group on Thursday reported a 13.4 percent decline in 1996 profits, yet the shares rose amid perceptions that BTR's reorganisation will begin to pay off this year, dealers said.
The shares have rebounded 26p, or 10.7 percent so far this week, and 30.5p, or 12.8 percent, since February 27, following a sharp decline in January and February.
